step1_analysis.description: An asymmetric inverter structure that provides two different switching thresholds at nodes N0 and N2. It is used as a comparator/quantizer stage in a non-uniform quantizer for a low-power heart-rate sensor.

paper_reference.title: A 0.5V <4μW CMOS Photoplethysmographic Heart-Rate Sensor IC Based on a Non-Uniform Quantizer

sky130_expected.calculation: Pull-up is 1 PMOS (W/L=10), pull-down is 2 NMOS (W/L=5). Beta_n = 1.35mA/V^2, Beta_p = 0.5mA/V^2. Vm ≈ (1.8 - 0.42 + 0.42*sqrt(2.7)) / (1 + sqrt(2.7)) ≈ 0.78V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard CMOS threshold equation with effective beta ratios.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pull-up is 2 PMOS (W/L=5), pull-down is 1 NMOS (W/L=10). Beta_n = 2.7mA/V^2, Beta_p = 0.25mA/V^2. Vm ≈ (1.8 - 0.42 + 0.42*sqrt(10.8)) / (1 + sqrt(10.8)) ≈ 0.64V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Stronger pull-down and weaker pull-up compared to N0 shifts the threshold lower.

sky130_expected.calculation: At 1MHz with 10fF load: P = f * C * Vdd^2 = 1e6 * 10e-15 * 1.8^2 = 32.4nW. Static power is ~1nW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominates at 1MHz. Scaled to 1.8V supply from the paper's 0.5V.

t_delay_n0.description: Propagation delay from input N1 to output N0

sky130_expected.calculation: t = C * dV / I_avg. C=10fF, dV=0.9V, I_avg ≈ 0.6mA. t ≈ 15ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast switching due to small load and strong drive at 1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard nominal voltage for SKY130 1.8V devices.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Testbench uses 1.8V to characterize the SKY130 devices, though the original paper used 0.5V.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the dual switching thresholds and propagation delays of the multi-threshold inverter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Multi-Threshold Inverter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N2 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN N1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 500n 1000n)
CLOAD0 N0 0 10f
CLOAD2 N2 0 10f

.control
* DC Sweep for VTC
dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_threshold_n0 when v(N0)=0.9 fall=1
meas dc v_threshold_n2 when v(N2)=0.9 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 2000n
meas tran t_delay_hl_n0 trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_delay_lh_n0 trig v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_delay_hl_n2 trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_delay_lh_n2 trig v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N2) val=0.9 rise=1

* Power measurement
meas tran integ_current integ i(VVDD) from=0 to=1000n
let dynamic_power = -integ_current * 1.8 / 1000n
print dynamic_power

* Static Power
op
let static_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print static_power

quit
.endc
